scientific_question: Do domain-specific policies selected before evaluation retain task feasibility and bounded regret on new matched closed-loop streams in three independently implemented heterogeneous models?
loss: 1-task_success + 0.05*within-condition normalized control cost + 0.05*within-condition normalized terminal error
claim_boundary: Prospectively specified new-stream paired computational closed loops in three heterogeneous models. This is not leave-physical-domain validation, source-controller replay, HIL, hardware or proof of universal optimality.
